turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My trumpet smells weird. How often am I meant to clean it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ideally a quick rinse every couple of weeks and a proper bath once a month or so. A smell usually means it's overdue.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then give it a full bath. Lukewarm water with a bit of washing up liquid, and take the valves and slides out first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, and another thing. My son wants to do something for the school talent show and he's asking me to help him choose.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A few choices coming. No comments till the end, please.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He could play a solo piano piece he's been practising for months.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or start a little band with his two best mates, they'd have about three weeks to rehearse.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He also mentioned writing a rap about the school dinners, which would be funny.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's everything. Now you can weigh in.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What's he most excited about? If he lights up talking about the rap, that energy will come through on stage. If he wants to impress, the piano solo is the safe and lovely option.
